# spotlight_runner (Resource)

A runner that calls Spotlight with a token, to claim and run its workspace's work. Writing runners needs a token granted the `runners` scope. Import it as `<workspace id>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "runner_build_1_token" {
  description = "The token the runner build-1 calls with"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "spotlight_runner" "build_1" {
  workspace_id  = spotlight_workspace.acme.id
  name          = "build-1"
  labels        = ["vpc-internal"]
  token         = var.runner_build_1_token
  token_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) What the runner is called, and what a line or station names in `runners` to place its work on it. It is fixed for the runner's life, so changing it replaces the runner.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace the runner belongs to. Changing it replaces the runner.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `labels` (Set of String) What a line or station may name in `runners` to place its work here, beside the runner's name, as in `vpc-internal`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The token the runner calls with: 32 to 255 URL-safe characters, as a generated password would be. Spotlight keeps only its hash. Left out, Spotlight issues one when it creates the runner, which Terraform does not keep. It is sent to Spotlight and never stored in the plan or the state, so it needs Terraform 1.11 or later; change `token_version` to send it again.
- `token_version` (Number) Any number; change it whenever `token` changes, so Terraform sends the new value.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `build-1`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the runner is created, and never changed.
- `trust` (String) The key of the runner trust the runner enrolled through, or null when it holds a token.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the runner; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_runner.build_1
  id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/build-1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A runner is imported by its workspace's id and its name.
terraform import spotlight_runner.build_1 5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/build-1
```
